summary.headline: Ninth Sign and Journeys
summary.text: Astrological judgments from the ninth sign concern journeys: fortunes and malefics indicate success or impediment, while the ninth-house lord in the ascendant or midheaven signifies travel-related pleasure, marriage, knowledge, authority, and gains. Venus, Jupiter, Mercury, Saturn, and Mars are assigned specific outcomes involving betrothal, empire, learning, aquatic and earthly goods, soldiers, princes, wars, and armies.
